vulnerable_code:
async def get_tenant_db(
    x_tenant_id: str = Header(..., alias="X-Tenant-ID"),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
) -> AsyncGenerator[AsyncSession, None]:
    engine = get_tenant_engine(x_tenant_id)
    async_session = sessionmaker(engine, class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False)
    async with async_session() as session:
        yield session

@router.get("/tenants/audit-vault")
async def list_audit_vault_records(
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_tenant_db)
):
    records = await db.execute(select(AuditEntry).order_by(AuditEntry.timestamp.desc()))
    return records.scalars().all()
diagnosis: The get_tenant_db dependency initializes a database session for the tenant specified in the X-Tenant-ID HTTP header, but fails to check whether current_user is an authorized member of that tenant organization. An authenticated attacker can supply any enterprise tenant ID in the header to connect directly to that tenant's database schema and dump their audit records.
